programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers.

programme.desc: A series of reports presenting the customs and life situation of women living in distant corners of the globe.Journalist Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.Stops in the third edition of the program include Samoa, Ghana and India.Together with her interlocutors, she experiences their joys and sorrows and participates in everyday activities.This allows her to understand contrasts and learn about different approaches to femininity in different parts of the world During her trip to India, Martyna Wojciechowska meets a family who, according to Hindu tradition, takes care of the Karni Mata temple in Rajasthan.The religious building is inhabited by over 20,000 rats, which are the incarnations of clan members.Manisha and Diksha take care of the rodents and provide them with food.Martyna also meets Ćitra, who tells her about her first meeting with her husband and shows her the typical outfit of Indian women - a colorful sari.Then, under the supervision of a hairdresser working in the middle of the street, the traveler takes on the role of a barber.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places The host visits the Dixie Dude Ranch, which was created for tourists.You can ride a horse here, feel like a resident of the prairie and experience the cowboy life.There are dozens of similar places in Texas.Marcin Prokop will try to find out whether they show the truth about the everyday life of the inhabitants of this part of America.There will also be a Polish accent.In the nearby town of Bandera there is a church built by Poles, where the parish priest is an emigrant from Silesia.Finally, a meeting with Ezekiel Mitchell, a professional bull rider, who will tell the host where his fascination with this dangerous sport comes from.
